title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Joshua 21: the cities given to the Levites and Yahweh's faithfulness to Israel.

questions.text: What had Yahweh commanded through Moses to give the Levites, according to their heads?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 21:2 the Levites say Yahweh commanded through Moses to give them cities to dwell in, with pasture lands for their livestock.

answers.text: A tribal territory of their own
Cities to dwell in, with pasture lands

questions.text: Who had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:4 says the children of Aaron the priest had thirteen cities by lot out of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

questions.text: How many cities did the children of Merari have?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:7 says the children of Merari had twelve cities out of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

questions.text: After whom was Kiriath Arba named?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:11 says Kiriath Arba was named after the father of Anak.

questions.text: Who received the fields and villages of Hebron?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:12 says the fields of the city and its villages were given to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

questions.text: Which of these cities was given out of the tribe of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:17-18 lists Gibeon, Geba, Anathoth and Almon out of the tribe of Benjamin.

questions.text: Which group received Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:20-21 says the rest of the children of Kohath received Shechem out of the tribe of Ephraim.

answers.text: The rest of the children of Kohath
The children of Aaron the priest

questions.text: Out of which tribe did the Gershonites receive Kedesh in Galilee?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:32 says the Gershonites received Kedesh in Galilee out of the tribe of Naphtali.

questions.text: How many cities did the Levites have in all among the possessions of Israel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:41 says all the cities of the Levites were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

questions.text: What does the end of the chapter say about Yahweh's good promises to Israel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:45 says nothing failed of any good thing Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel; all came to pass.

answers.text: Most were still waiting to be fulfilled
They were postponed for a later generation
Nothing failed; all came to pass
Only the promise of land was kept
